ACT:EO:283>EO:9830.effective_basis: Express wording in the enacting clause: "it is hereby ordered as follows, effective May 1, 1947:" (span in effective_wording), which introduces Parts I, II and III alike; Part III (the revocation list) has no separate date. Signed "February 24, 1947" (signature block after the last Part III row); FR filed Feb. 24, 1947, published 12 FR 1259 of 1947-02-25. The OFR disposition note date 1947-02-24 is the signing date, not the effective date. Reading that the preamble date governs Part III is the natural one but the reviewer must accept or reject it.

ACT:EO:283>EO:9830.notes: EO 9830 Part III (OCR heading "P art  H I") is a single sentence "The following Executive orders are hereby revoked:" followed by a one-per-line list of 54 orders (52 numbered, 2 unnumbered; EO 8894 and EO 9004 are among them), ending at the signature block; no savings, exception or 'nothing herein' wording found anywhere in the held text (searched nothing in/herein, shall not affect, heretofore, remain/continue in effect, saving, notwithstanding). The FR contents table on PDF page 2 also lists these numbers ("Executive orders revoked" finding aid); the naming span is taken from Part III itself, not the finding aid. Target row 'No. 283 of December 8, 1904.': number and date match the target's signing date (1904-12-08). Target text: jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_283.txt (official GPO 1911 compilation, OCR). AI producer hypothesis; not a review, status or certification. Agent-located record (act_overrides); an independent AI review upheld it. Hypothesis only: not human certification and not a status.
ACT:EO:283>EO:9830.producer_d6: Searched held FR texts (jobs/fr-originals full_run, 6,652 files) for any instrument naming EO 283 or the order of December 8, 1904 other than EO 9830: none (hits for '283' are page numbers only). Searched the held Isthmian Canal Commission compilation (178 texts, 1904-1911): no other order names it or touches the citizenship waiver. Dossier chain empty; no own-term end. LEADS (not ends, not decided): Civil Service Rule V sec. 1 as restated by EO 7915 (1938-06-24, held) requires applicants to be citizens of or owe allegiance to the United States, with no express revocation of EO 283 (possible implied tension only); Schedule A (EO 8043 para. 8, EO 9653) excepts most Federal positions on the Isthmus of Panama from examination. COVERAGE GAP: the held FR corpus starts in 1936, so instruments of 1905-1935 (e.g. the Panama Canal Act of 1912 and EO 1888 of 1914-02-02 on conditions of employment on the Isthmus, neither held) cannot be searched; an earlier end of EO 283 in that period cannot be excluded. No earlier end found in held sources, but D6 is incomplete for 1905-1935.
